summary: First-finish smoke test of K Bridge Partners site. All 7 backend endpoints pass on public URL (GET /api/, /api/insights returns 4 seeded Korean posts with expected slugs, /api/insights/{slug} 200 for valid + 404 for invalid, POST /api/insights creates and returns slug, POST /api/contact valid returns 201-ish 200 with id, GET /api/contact lists, POST /api/contact invalid email -> 422). Frontend: home loads, desktop nav to /insights works and shows 5 insight cards (4 seeded + 1 test-created via POST), clicking insight-card-site-selection-methodology navigates to detail page with Korean content, contact form submits successfully and resets fields, FAQ accordion toggles to data-state=open, mobile-menu-toggle opens mobile drawer with nav-home visible.
passed: GET /api/insights -> 4 posts with expected Korean slugs
POST /api/contact valid -> 200 with id; GET /api/contact lists
Desktop nav-insights navigates to /insights and renders cards from backend
Insight detail page /insights/:slug renders Korean content
Contact form: valid submit resets fields (integration with backend works)
Mobile menu toggle opens drawer with mobile-nav-home

failed.issue: Could not conclusively detect a visible toast element after empty-form submit via generic selectors (.toast, [role=status], [data-sonner-toast]). Actual toast may still render via sonner in a portal that our selectors missed; functional impact not confirmed.
failed.evidence: Playwright query for toast selectors returned None after empty submit; however successful submit path works and form resets.
